authority_basis: Exact ScienceBase child item identities and titles recovered without numeric payload access.
USGS release metadata independently states bathymetry and acoustic-backscatter are supplied as 10 m GeoTIFFs from the 2015 Reson 7111 survey.
cs1_payload_acceptance_gate: Download only the exact bathymetry child-item route.
Before morphology metrics, require a readable TIFF payload or archive containing exactly one non-quickview TIFF raster.
Require projected georeference and effective cell size within 0.1 percent of nominal 10 m.
Abort on HTML, empty, ambiguous multiple-raster, or non-10m payload.
Record payload SHA256 before metric generation.
